claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: MIXED outcome verified. On deterministic Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 localhost (SEED=42) with graded session_status_check (401->1.0,403->0.5,500->0.75) and unauthenticated /schema probe, 8 co-occurring conditions x60 (n=480), behavioral-structural correlation is near-zero r=0.0335 (r2=0.001) with 95% two-sided CI [-0.056,0.123] (one-sided upper 0.108). Equivalence confirmed ONLY for margins delta>=0.15 (shared variance <2.25%, >97.75% independent): TOST and CI both pass at 0.15 (p_upper 0.005) and 0.20, fail at delta=0.10 (p_upper 0.072>0.05, CI 0.123>0.10) and fail CI at 0.12 (0.123>0.12) despite TOST p=0.028. Therefore independent parallel channels are justified ONLY if product tolerates |r|<0.15; if delta=0.10 (<1% shared variance) required then n insufficient (CI needs ~865, TOST ~610 vs current 480). C1 (TP=1.0 Wilson 0.9398), C2 (8/8 variance), C4 (FP=0.0) hold. C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL, not VALIDATED; do not promote to Product Core beyond bounded parallel-channel assumption at delta=0.15. No inference to real APIs, RS256/ES256/OAuth/OIDC, DB/cache/CDN stochasticity, alternative behavioral mappings, or production routing without new data. Per-condition table and tradeoff min_n_tost require correction before archival.
